abstract: Monitors statutory environmental impact permits, discharge standards, and ecological monitoring
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENV). The Environmental compliance officer (ENV) oversees regulatory approvals for water reuse schemes, monitoring statutory environmental impact permits, discharge standards, and ecological impacts across candidate designs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Odor mitigation assessment（ODOR）
information_points.content:
ENV-ODOR-TMO：For the Indirect aquifer recharge infiltration basin, the measured boundary hydrogen sulfide concentration along the perimeter fence line is 2 ppb.
ENV-ODOR-XHX：For the Direct potable reuse multi-barrier train, perimeter air monitoring records a boundary hydrogen sulfide concentration of 8 ppb during peak summer operations.
ENV-ODOR-YJE：For the Engineered wetlands sequential treatment system, the boundary hydrogen sulfide concentration is measured at 5 ppb during peak summer operations.

information_points.title: Monitors statutory environmental impact permits, discharge standards, and ecological monitoring（PERMIT）
information_points.content:
ENV-PERMIT-DND：When evaluated exclusive of brine discharge and concentrate management facilities, statutory environmental impact clearance is not granted (false) for the Direct potable reuse multi-barrier train.
ENV-PERMIT-ODN：For the Direct potable reuse multi-barrier train, statutory environmental impact clearance is confirmed (true) based on an assessment inclusive of brine discharge and concentrate management facilities.
ENV-PERMIT-GLE：For the Indirect aquifer recharge infiltration basin, statutory environmental impact clearance is granted (true) evaluated inclusive of brine discharge and concentrate management facilities.
ENV-PERMIT-9G9：For the Engineered wetlands sequential treatment system, statutory environmental impact clearance has not been obtained (false) on the basis inclusive of brine discharge and concentrate management facilities.
